none: PAS NLM-FCAB37: Roman Coin: Nummus fraction of House of Theodosius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus fraction of House of Theodosius (379-395), issue of 388-395, Reece period 21. Obverse description: Bust right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [---]AV[G]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [V]ICT[ORIA] AVGG[G]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 14.1mm, Weight: 1.14gms, die axis: possibly 6
